title: Builder Signals · 2026-10-05
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 25 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 11 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
featured.summaryEn: Sam Altman said he is very uncomfortable with people ascribing religious force to AI models or surrendering human judgment to them, and called this a real safety issue — shifting the safety conversation from model capability to how humans relate to AI.
featured.insightZh: Sam Altman 罕见地就 AI 的「神化」倾向公开表态：他对有人试图赋予 AI 模型某种宗教性力量、或把人类判断「交给」AI 感到非常不安，并明确认为这是一个真实的安全问题。这把讨论从模型能力本身，拉到了人类与 AI 的关系层面。

featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux (Codex & ChatGPT, OpenAI) said the team is "locking in": only simplifications, efficiency for more usage, groundbreaking features, or new models — because feedback clearly says users want things simpler. He also shared that by making inbox zero an active goal for his agent, it batch-deleted unneeded email categories, labeled emails by work type, and walked him through replies while searching for context in the background — his first-ever inbox zero.
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布团队「锁定」方向：接下来只做四类事——简化、提升效率以支撑更多用量、突破性功能、新模型。他坦言有时要超前投入，但用户反馈很明确：大家要的是更简单。另外他分享了个人用例：把「收件箱清零」设为 agent 的主动目标后，它批量删除了无需保留的邮件类别、按工作类型自动打标签，并逐封引导他处理需要回复的邮件、在后台检索相关上下文——这是他人生第一次实现 inbox zero。

featured.sourceName: The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck
featured.title: Who Feeds the GPUs? Inside AI's Hidden $30B Layer | Renen Hallak, VAST Data
featured.summaryEn: VAST Data, valued at $30B and profitable, sits in the software infrastructure middle of the AI "five-layer cake" — Renen Hallak frames it as the operating system of the AI era, and argues enterprises will own AI factories and distill their IP into model weights they control. Hallak explains that every layer of the stack must be rebuilt — from 10kW to 500kW racks to fast networks and large SSDs — because AI works with images, video, audio and language at far larger scale. One AI cloud customer, after forecasting 500PB over three years, just asked for an extra 2 exabytes. Technically, VAST replaces "shared nothing" clusters (which break down past ~100 nodes due to quadratic communication) with a "shared everything" design using NVMe over Fabrics, so all nodes see all data; one customer runs multiple exabytes, tens of TB/s and tens of thousands of nodes in a single cluster. This week's lau…
featured.insightZh: 估值 300 亿美元、已盈利的 VAST Data 定位于 AI「五层蛋糕」中间的软件基础设施层，CEO Renen Hallak 认为它是 AI 时代的操作系统，企业终将拥有自己的 AI 工厂，把 IP 沉淀为自有模型权重。 VAST Data 创始人兼 CEO Renen Hallak 借用黄仁勋的「五层蛋糕」（电力—硬件—软件基础设施—模型—应用）来定位公司：正处中间的软件基础设施层，负责管理计算、存储、网络，并通过数据库与训练/推理功能让数据「可用」。他强调从机架功率（10kW 到 500kW）到网络、SSD，整套栈都需要重做，因为 AI 处理的是图片、视频、语音和自然语言，数据量和访问速度要求远超大数据时代。他举例：一家 AI 云客户原本预计三年需要 500PB，上周又追加了 2EB。 架构上，他解释传统「shared nothing」集群节点间通信呈平方级增长，超过约 100 个节点就难以为继；VAST 反其道做「shared everything」——借助高速网络与 NVMe over Fabrics，把 SSD 和元数据放在网络另一侧，让所有节点像直连一样看到全部数据，无需互相通信。目前已有客户在单集群内跑到数 EB、数十 TB/s、数万节点。本周发布的重点是「模型管理」：模型正变成像 GPU、SSD 一样需要被调度的资源；其中一块是机密计算——借助 NVIDIA 硬件端到端加密，让企业可以在自有环境里跑闭源模型推理，既不暴露企业数据，也不暴露模型厂商权重，从而把模型厂商的市场打开到受监管行业。 对企业，他认为规模到一定程度时「买比租划算」，长期每个组织的 IP 会被蒸馏进自己拥有的模型权重，通过强化学习持续微调。商业上，VAST 卖软件、毛利高，伴随 AI 大约「每两年 10 倍」的增长愈发高效并已盈利；早年 VC 不看好这一层，反而让竞争更少。他对 Neo Cloud 的判断是：赢家是在需求之前就建好产能的人。组织上他学习 Elon Musk：不断找出并消除限制因素，保持扁平，「坏消息要大声、经常地说，好消息只说一次、轻声说」。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie says agent adoption is bimodal: coding and coding-adjacent work has taken off, everything else hasn't. Even in coding, only a small share of developers run parallel background agents. For the rest of knowledge work, adoption requires rebuilding workflows, rewiring data, new accountability and liability practices, governance/compliance changes and security upgrades — so expect 100x more agent adoption from here.
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为 AI agent 的采用目前高度「双峰」：编程及其邻近任务已经起飞，其余几乎都还没动。即便在编程内部，也只有一小部分开发者在并行跑后台 agent，多数人仍在 1:1 使用 agent。至于其他知识工作，真正的 agent 落地还很早，因为它不是部署一个聊天系统提升研究效率那么简单，而是要重构工作流、重新打通数据、建立 agent 参与决策时的问责与责任机制、更新治理合规范式并升级安全体系。他的判断是：未来 agent 采用量还会再涨 100 倍。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人）
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru (Sr Director, AI at Meta; ex-Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana) argues AI adoption is largely a product problem: even among the ~2% who pay, usage is shallow because most AI products look like cockpits with 100 levers — connectors, permissions, model selection, token usage. He expects things to look materially different within 12 months as product teams make AI easier to use.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 认为当下 AI 普及主要是个产品问题：即便在约 2% 已付费的 AI 用户里，使用深度也很浅。核心原因是大多数 AI 产品像「有 100 根操纵杆的飞机驾驶舱」——连接器、权限、模型选择、token 用量等一堆概念。他判断这种情况正在改变，未来 12 个月随着产品团队成熟、把 AI 做得更易用，格局会明显不同。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch says security will become a larger function in software companies — both verification engineering and capital allocation ("what surface should I throw most tokens at?"). For startups it's a trust challenge against sophisticated AI adversaries, but also an opportunity given the dire state of cybersecurity. He also posited that AI will make everything free, including itself, with free energy as the last domino.
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 认为安全在软件公司里的比重会越来越大：安全既是「验证工程」（比如确认代码大概率内存安全），也是「资本配置」（该把最多 token 砸在哪块攻击面上）。对初创公司这是挑战也是机会——AI 攻击者越来越强，大家凭什么信任一个「两个人加一条狗」的公司？但反过来，全球网络安全现状糟糕、对中心化依赖加深，小团队有大量可以颠覆的空间，他很期待投资。他还抛出一个判断：AI 会让一切变得免费，包括 AI 本身，最后倒下的多米诺骨牌是免费能源。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人（前 Notion、Stripe）
items.summaryEn: Ryo Lu (designed Cursor, Notion, Stripe) wrote on "convergence to the mean": when everyone copies what works, products become polished, interchangeable and lifeless. AI makes this loop frictionless — access to every perspective isn't the same as having one — producing "a tidal wave of mid." He argues for approaching software as artists do, as a medium expressing beliefs about how life should feel. If we can make almost anything, deciding what deserves to exist matters more: "what is the point of everyone being abl…
items.insightZh: Ryo Lu 写了篇长文《向均值收敛》：当所有人都看别人来决定做什么，最终就不再做属于自己的东西——抄成功的语言、审美和功能，结果一切都精致却可互换，「没有错，也没有生命」。AI 让这个循环零摩擦：它能参考的东西比人一辈子见到的都多，但拥有所有视角不等于拥有一个视角；不带自己意图让它替你选，就会得到「看起来合理、容易通过」的东西，然后上线、度量、复制、再喂回去——「一波平庸的海啸」。他主张用艺术家的方式做软件：软件本身就是一种媒介，表达着对生活应有感受的信念。当我们几乎什么都能做出来，决定什么值得存在反而更重要。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 普通合伙人（前 Dropbox CTO）
items.summaryEn: Aditya Agarwal (GP at SPC, ex-Dropbox CTO) notes that even the super rich get only 20–30 minutes with the world's top cancer doctor. AI both democratizes access and makes available time unlimited for every individual — the practical effect of intelligence too cheap to meter.
items.insightZh: Aditya Agarwal 指出一个常见误解：以为足够有钱就能无限获得世界顶级医生、律师或创意专家。现实是，顶尖癌症医生无论你多有钱也只会见你 20-30 分钟。AI 的颠覆在于它既让获取变得普惠，又让每个人可用的时间变得无限——这就是「智能便宜到无需计量」的实际效果。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Nikunj Kothari (FPV Ventures) watches the innovator's dilemma as personal agents become inevitable: Amazon protects its ads cash cow and brand, while DoorDash is slowly opening up via CLIs and ordering by text. He also cautioned that "tokenmaxxing" for its own sake isn't useful — explore the edges, then find the real purpose.
items.insightZh: Nikunj Kothari 关注个人 agent 时代的「创新者窘境」：Amazon 在保护广告现金牛和品牌，而体量更小的 DoorDash 正（慢慢地）通过 CLI 和短信下单向 agent 开放。他另外提醒：为了用而用、单纯「刷 token」在当下并没有意义，可以短期探索边界，但要找到真正的用途。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger asked for help from anyone at Google, as OpenClaw's Android app has been stuck in review for over a week, and joked that everyone is building the same thing.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 作者 Peter Steinberger 公开求助：OpenClaw 的 Android 应用在 Google 审核中卡了一周多，问有没有人认识 Google 的人能帮忙。他还调侃大家其实都在做同一个东西。

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.summaryEn: Anthropic is merging Claude Cowork and chat into one Claude — from quick questions to handing over a noon-deadline report that Claude keeps working on after you close your laptop. New today: Claude Docs and Claude Slides (beta), plus Claude Design inside conversations, with direct editing, presenting, and PowerPoint/PDF export. Users said the frustrating part was deciding where a task belonged, so Claude now figures out what a task needs, using existing context, skills and connectors. Tasks can be scheduled (e.g., every Monday); by default Claude asks before acting, with an option to only check in when needed. Rolling out to Pro and Max first, Team and Free soon; Enterprise admins get at least 30 days' notice.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Cowork 与聊天合并为「一个 Claude」：无论是快速提问还是交出一份中午要交的报告，Claude 都能接手，甚至在你合上电脑后继续工作。同时上线 Claude Docs、Claude Slides（beta），Claude Design 也能在对话里直接用——可协同写文档、生成幻灯片，直接编辑、演示或导出为 PowerPoint/PDF。合并原因是用户反馈最烦的是「判断任务该放哪儿」，且跨产品上下文不连贯；现在 Claude 自行判断任务所需能力，沿用已有的上下文、skills 和 connectors。可设定每周一自动生成报告；默认执行动作前先询问，也可改为仅在需要时确认。先向 Pro、Max 用户在 Web/桌面/移动端逐步推送，Team 和 Free 随后；Enterprise 管理员会在变更前至少 30 天收到通知。
